description: Keyword search of ONE model, the articles of the website, with a category filter no other keyword search has. Use it to LIST the articles on a subject; to get the passages that answer a question, use search_sections_semantically. Returns pk, title, url, image_url (absolute URL of the large article image, null when there is none), category_code, meta_description and relevance score.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

query.description: Words to search in the article texts.

name: search_articles
title: Search articles
